summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. (BEN) filed an 8-K reporting its entry into definitive agreements forming INTERVENT Health AI, Inc., a 50/50 joint venture with INTERVENT International, LLC to develop and commercialize AI-powered health coaching. BEN contributed its conversational AI through a wholly owned subsidiary, SKYE AI USA, under a five-year exclusive North American arrangement. Each party received 32.5 million shares of Class A common stock (50% each) and 5 million shares of Class B preferred stock at $1.00 per share for pre-paid licenses. The board has three members: one from each party plus one independent director. The filing is a routine formation agreement without acquisition or change of control terms, thus not a special situation.
